# CRAFTLOGIC

> CRAFTLOGIC is a software development company based in Islamabad, Pakistan. We build fast, high-converting custom software, websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms for businesses in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, UAE and beyond. Minimum project size is $500, charged per project (not hourly).

## Services

- Business websites: custom, fast, SEO-ready websites for service businesses. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)
- E-commerce stores: online stores with fast checkout. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)
- Mobile apps: iOS and Android apps. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)
- SaaS platforms: custom web applications and dashboards. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)
- AI & automation: AI chatbots and workflow automation. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)
- SEO & speed: Google ranking, Core Web Vitals, local SEO. [Services](https://craftlogic.live/#services)

## About

- CRAFTLOGIC is a solo-run studio founded on 20 November 2025 by Muhammad Ismail, a full-stack web developer. Every project is built by hand — no templates, no fake reviews, no invented claims. Clients can claim a Free Homepage Preview before paying anything.
